verses.english: “There are, mendicants, these two kinds of increase.
Increase in things of the flesh and increase in the teaching.
These are the two kinds of increase.

verses.pali: Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, imesaṁ dvinnaṁ vepullānaṁ yadidaṁ dhammavepullan”ti.
verses.english: The better of these two kinds of increase is increase in the teaching.”
